_comment: AWS Physical AI Toolchain configuration. The workstation amiMapping uses the NVIDIA Isaac Sim Marketplace AMI (product ID: prodview-bl35herdyozhw, https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-bl35herdyozhw). You MUST subscribe to this product in the AWS Marketplace before deploying, or the EC2 launch will fail with a subscription required error. The AMI comes pre-baked with NVIDIA drivers, NICE DCV, and Isaac Sim installed.

arena._comment: Fill account_id and create both token files on the machine running the notebook. Tokens stay outside this repository. The notebook and ordinary pai arena commands read this section; explicit CLI flags override these defaults.
arena._optional: Use a named AWS profile if needed; null retains the environment or instance-role credentials. Other values below are editable defaults.
arena._video: Auto records Arena evaluation and reports video unavailable for other simulators. Only recordings belonging to the reported run are shown.
